MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 13
   C. 7
   D. 17

2. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 56
   B. 57
   C. 15
   D. 1

3. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 7
   C. 14
   D. 50

4. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 4

5. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 10

6. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 12
   C. 42
   D. 36

7. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 13
   C. 41
   D. 3

8. Solve for x: x + 4 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 9

9. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 48
   C. 24
   D. 144

10. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 5
   C. 25
   D. 26

11. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 13
   C. 170
   D. 169

12. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 12 cm³
   B. 18 cm³
   C. 27 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — 13
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: c² = a² + b²
2. Substitute values: c² = 5² + 12²
3. c² = 25 + 144
4. c² = 169
5. c = 13
Final Answer: 13 cm
Mark reminder: method mark for Pythagoras; accuracy mark for hypotenuse

2. A — 56
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Product = first factor × second factor
2. Substitute values: Product = 8 × 7
3. Product = 56
Final Answer: 56
Mark reminder: method mark for multiplication; accuracy mark for answer
